resources.string: Monitors active foreground apps locally on your device to enforce Partial App Shield (blocking social media like YouTube, Instagram, Facebook) and Full Phone Lockdown, and blocks Settings/Uninstall tampering while a Guardian Timer is active. Zero data leaves your device.
Prevents Aegis Lock from being uninstalled while a focus timer or Guardian Passcode session is active.
Aegis Lock protection prevents uninstallation during active distraction locks.
